lines.translation: All beings are Yours, O Merciful Lord.
You cherish Your devotees.
Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.
Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord is always with me.
The Messenger of Death does not approach me.
God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.
True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੀਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusaman maar vidaare sagale daas kau sumat deetee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||
God has blessed all places with prosperity.
I have returned again safe and sound.
Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.
It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa daataa satigur taa kee saranee paaeeai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: darasan bhetat hot ana(n)daa dookh gaiaa har gaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and one sings the Lord's Praises. ||1||
Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam japahu naamo aaraadhahu gur poore kee saranaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi paraapat jis dhur likhiaa soee pooran bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jee naam rahaa liv laaee ||2||25||89||
lines.translation: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan karaavan har a(n)tarajaamee jan apune kee raakhai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar hot jag bheetar sabad guroo ras chaakhai ||1||
lines.translation: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublime essence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too samarath saran kaa daataa aath pahar tumh dhiaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on You. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhajan kare prabh teraa tisai a(n)desaa naahee ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur charan lage bhau mitiaa har gun gaae man maahee ||2||
lines.translation: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ghanere satigur deeaa dilaasaa ||
lines.translation: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jin ghar aae sobhaa setee pooran hoee aasaa ||3||
lines.translation: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa gur pooree mat jaa kee pooran prabh ke kaamaa ||
lines.translation: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur charanee laag tario bhav saagar jap naanak har har naamaa ||4||26||90||
lines.translation: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kirapaal deen dukh bha(n)jan aape sabh bidh thaatee ||
lines.translation: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised all devices.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi raakh leeo jan apunaa gur poorai beRee kaatee ||1||
lines.translation: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away his bonds. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gur govi(n)d sad dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal kales mitahi is tan te man chi(n)diaa phal paaeeai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t jaa ke sabh keene prabh oochaa agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g naanak naam dhiaaiaa mukh oojal bhae darabaaraa ||2||27||91||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.
Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.
He gave me His hand, and protected me.
I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||
